newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Polnobanka 96 net profit SKK 163 mln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Polnobanka 96 net profit SKK 163 mln.

text.p: Privately-held Polnobanka a.s., Slovakia's fourth largest commercial bank, on Wednesday said its 1996 after-tax profit totalled about 163 million crowns, some 50 percent more than in the previous year.
The bank said in a statement that its balance sheet totalled 29.1 billion crowns at the end of last year, an increase of 35 percent from 1995.

Its total credits as of December 1996 were 16.5 billion crowns, while client deposits amounted to 15.4 billion crowns, up 35 percent from 1995. No comparative figure for extended loans in 1995 was made available.

The bank's main shareholders are Slovenska Poistovna, the country's largest insurer (31.9 percent), the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (20 percent), and the Slovak agriculture ministry (8.6 percent). About 20 percent of Polnobanka shares are held by small shareholders.
Last year, two north Italian regional investment groups, Unicredito S.p.A. and Finest S.p.A., took 2.6 and 2.8 percent stakes respectively in Polnobanka.

The two Italian partners have also asked the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) to allow them increase their holdings in Polnobanka up to a total 15 percent. The NBS has not said whether it has approved the increase.
Neither Polnobanka officials nor the Italian investors have so far said whether the increase of the Italian stake in the bank has occurred.
Last October, Polnobanka succesfully increased its basic capital by 600 million crowns to 1.85 billion through a share issue with prepurchase rights for the current shareholders.
